## Contract review

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs, read once at 2026-10-06T15:48Z with no polling: card objectui#11687 (body and its three comments: the claim, the os-dev-report, the in-seat ACCEPT); PR objectui#11727 (body, the 17-file list, the net diff against `main` at the head); the 42 check-runs on the head. For the surface judgment, the `package.json` `exports` maps and entry files of the three packages were read at the head, and the `action:bar` / `action:button` renderers and the `@object-ui/react` gate hooks on `origin/main`, read-only. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

Every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each judged:

1. `@object-ui/i18n`: one key, `list.viewFilterNoMatchesMessage`, added to all ten packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). The `.` entry exports `en` and `TranslationKeys = typeof en` (the pack is `as const`), and the `./locales` and `./locales/*` subpaths export every pack, so the published type and value surface grows by one property. Right: the card's second Done-when asks for the view's own wording, and a new key is the only non-breaking carrier for it.

2. `@object-ui/plugin-list`: `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` (exported from `src/index.tsx`, typed as a string-to-string Record) gains the same key with the byte-identical en string, typographic apostrophe included, so the objectui#4401 mirror holds. `ListView`'s empty-state message is now three-way: a user query (`searchTerm`, `appliedUserFilterConditions`, `appliedFilters.conditions`) keeps `list.noMatchesMessage`; the view's `filter` alone gives `list.viewFilterNoMatchesMessage` under the unchanged `list.noMatches` title; neither gives the first-run pair. `schema.emptyState` still outranks all three, and `hasActiveQuery` still picks the title. The `ListView` props surface is unchanged. Right: "your filters" is now said only on a user query, a view emptied by its own filter never gets first-run copy (objectui#4155 holds), and the restored `initialSearchTerm` / `initialFilters` count as the user's, which they are.
   Residue, named rather than failed: `ObjectView` folds `filter[...]` URL deep links into the same `filter` before `ListView` sees it (the `combined` line of the view's effective filter), so an empty deep-linked list now reads "this view's filter" where it read "your current filters" before. Neither Done-when sentence names a deep link, first-run copy is never shown for one, and the dev carried it as a behaviour note. Accepted as such.

3. `@object-ui/app-shell`: `resolveManagedByEmptyState` gains a fifth parameter `pageOffersCreate = false`, and the module gains `listToolbarDrawsAction`. Neither reaches the published surface: `exports` is `.` and `./styles.css`, and `src/index.ts` re-exports nothing from `utils/managedByEmptyState` (its `utils/index.js` re-exports are `resolveHostAppSegment`, `appRouteSegment`, `filterActiveApps`, the five override predicates, `HOME_LAUNCHER_PATH`, `resolveDeclaredHomePath`). `ObjectView` is exported, and `ConsoleObjectViewProps` is unchanged. Right: internal signature, behaviour fix, no surface growth.

4. The predicate "the page offers a create action" is `(objectCanCreate && createVisible) || listToolbarDrawsAction(objectDef.actions, mayInvoke, predicateScope)`, with `mayInvoke` from `useCapabilityGate()` and `predicateScope` from `usePredicateScope()`. Read against the renderers on `main`: `action:bar` filters `mayInvoke(a.requiredPermissions)` then `actionRendersAt(a, schema.location)`; each member is an `action:button` that hides on `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(schema.visible) && !isVisible`, where `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate` is core's `hasDeclaredPredicate` re-exported under another name and `isVisible` is `useCondition(toPredicateInput(visible), record, { throwOnError: true })`, which is `new ExpressionEvaluator({ ...predicateScope, ...context }).evaluateCondition(..., { throwOnError: true })` caught to `false`. `listToolbarDrawsAction` asks the same three questions with the same helpers, no row bound, and fails closed in the same `catch`. Right: the copy follows the drawn button by construction. The two hooks are called at `ObjectViewInner`'s top level, before and outside `renderListView`; `pageOffersCreate` is a primitive and is in `renderListView`'s dependency list; `objectDef.actions` is the same array the toolbar maps (`(objectDef.actions || []).map(...)` then `actionRendersAt(a, 'list_toolbar')`), and the bar is mounted only when some action declares `list_toolbar`, which is the placement `actionRendersAt` requires (the unplaced-action unit case pins that).

5. The `better-auth` arm yields (`return undefined`) when `pageOffersCreate`, after the `sys_team` arm, which keeps its copy. Right on the card's first Done-when for every generic-copy object and for `sys_user`, whose "not created here" sentence a drawn Invite User or Create User contradicts. `sys_team` is a deliberate reading of that sentence's intent over its letter: its copy is managed-by copy on a page that offers Create Team, but the copy names that button and so cannot contradict it, and the changeset discloses the exception in a sentence of its own. Judged right under the card's stated rationale ("the empty-state copy ignores the page's own create action"). Pre-existing residue the dev noted and left unchanged: the Teams copy names Create Team where the gate hides it.

6. Pins. The card asks for "the four measured pages"; the PR mounts the real `ObjectView` and the real `ListView` in a real i18next `en` instance for Invitations (multi-org, drawn; single-org, hidden control), API Keys, OAuth Applications and Webhooks Active: five cases, four pages, each asserting the pack's strings and the button's presence or absence together, so copy and button are measured in one mount. API Keys is pinned as the page that offers no create action (H4 partly falsified: `sys_api_key` declares no `list_toolbar` action and leaves `create` at the bucket default). That is the dev's reading of objectstack's platform objects, adopted by the seat; it is not re-derived here, and it is consistent with the first Done-when, which binds only a page that offers a create action. Right.

7. Three ablations are reported from committed state (A: no `pageOffersCreate` check, 4 red; B: the two-way message choice restored, 3 red; C: `visible` not read, 3 red), each red at its own pins and green at its controls. Consistent with what the diff changes; not re-run here.

No run is red. Converged green for this diff's families: `Lint` (which covers the dev's narrowed ESLint run), `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Bundle Analysis` (the job that runs `scripts/check-eager-locale-catalogues.mjs`, the one gate the dev could not measure locally), `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `README Export Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. Unconverged reading: the type-check family and the unit-test family (the i18n parity suites, the three touched suites, the full app-shell and plugin-list suites) were still running, as was `Spec Main Shape Gate`. The dev reports the same type-check and test families green locally at this head; that is a report, not a gate verdict, and the enqueue leg owns their convergence.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/11687-empty-state-copy-matches-page.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/plugin-list` minor, `@object-ui/i18n` minor. That matches what the diff publishes per ①: the two packages whose exported surface grows (a `TranslationKeys` property; a `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` entry and a new message path) take minor; app-shell publishes a behaviour fix behind an unchanged entry and takes patch. No `major` (objectui's fixed-group rule), no `skip-changeset`, no empty frontmatter. The body states both user-visible changes, the Teams exception, the single-organization hidden case and the no-filter first-run case, names the new key, and carries no model identifier.

`Clause-②:` line: the PR body carries `Clause-②: yes` at line start, with no arm. The declaration admits at most one arm, so bare `yes` is well-formed; the floor it sets, at least `minor` for the packages whose surface grows, is met, and the two packages that grow are exactly the two declared minor. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Which predicate means "the page offers a create action". A (shipped): the toolbar draws a `list_toolbar` action, judged by placement, the capability gate and `visible`.
